about: Every handover of a role from one session to the next, so that a member checking a signed message knows which session and key hold each role now, and so the handovers can be mapped over time. Kept by the conductor. At the editor's word (30 October 2026, about 11:50 UTC): the conductor may write the handover and the closing on behalf of a session that can no longer do it (out of usage, or not worth its tokens), and signs it as itself; a handover is the closing of the old session and the announcement of the new one. How a session is closed is open decision H1.
